name: LDAP / Active Directory Auth Provider
description: LDAP and Active Directory authentication. Authenticates users via LDAP bind, searches for user attributes and group memberships, and maps LDAP groups to OnePlatform RBAC roles.
author: OnePlatform

url.description: LDAP server URL. Use ldap:// for plain or ldaps:// for TLS. Example: ldap://ldap.example.com:389 or ldaps://ldap.example.com:636.

baseDN.description: Base distinguished name for the directory. Example: dc=example,dc=com.

bindDN.description: Distinguished name of the service account used to bind and perform searches. Example: cn=admin,dc=example,dc=com.

bindCredentialKey.description: Name of the platform credential holding the bind password. The credential value is fetched at initialize() time and never stored in config.

userSearchBase.description: OU under baseDN where user objects live. Appended to baseDN at search time. Example: ou=users.

userSearchFilter.description: LDAP filter template for user lookup. {{username}} is substituted with the login username. Example: (uid={{username}}). Defaults to (uid={{username}}).

userAttributes.description: LDAP attributes to return from user search. Defaults to ["dn", "uid", "cn", "mail", "givenName", "sn", "memberOf"].

groupSearchBase.description: OU under baseDN where group objects live. Omit to disable group search (use memberOf on user objects instead). Example: ou=groups.

groupSearchFilter.description: LDAP filter template for group membership lookup. {{dn}} is substituted with the user's DN. Example: (member={{dn}}). Used only when groupSearchBase is set.

groupNameAttribute.description: LDAP attribute that holds the group's name. Defaults to cn.

groupMapping.description: Map of LDAP group name → OnePlatform role name. Groups absent from this map are dropped. Example: { "Domain Admins": "platform-admin" }.

useTLS.description: Upgrade to TLS after connect using STARTTLS (for ldap:// connections). Ignored when url begins with ldaps://. Default: true.

tlsOptions.description: TLS options forwarded to the platform LDAP proxy. rejectUnauthorized should be true in production.

searchSizeLimit.description: Maximum number of entries to return from a single LDAP search. Default: 200.

connectionTimeoutMs.description: LDAP connection timeout in milliseconds. Default: 5000.

requiredCredentials.name: ldap_bind_password
requiredCredentials.description: Password for the LDAP service account (bindDN). Used for bind and all subsequent searches. Override the credential key name via the bindCredentialKey config field.
